stools.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EOn serial observation of his blood count, there was a significant decrease from 1.6 L (Saturday) to 26000 (yesterday distension. Patient complains of SOB after taking food and fluids.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient gives history of ?greenish-dark coloured stools.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESerial Platelet Count since Saturday\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESaturday - 1.6L\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EMonday - 99k\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ETues - 30k\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWednesday (Afternoon) - 26k\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo past medical history.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite - Normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDiet - mixed\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep - Normal now, but could not sleep in the first 4 days of fever.
